title: A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care
abstract: arXiv:2611.15004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram. We present CARMEN, a single encoder pretrained without labels on ten cardiorespiratory waveforms (2.27 million modality-hours). CARMEN accepts any combination of co-recorded signals from 10 s to 5 min, and a conditioning mechanism, LSCNorm, restores the absolute signal level that normalization removes; without it, the AUROC for intraoperative hypotension fell from 0.894 to 0.780. Across 19 tasks from Korean and US cohorts, the frozen encoder outperformed supervised models on 12 of 15 and three foundation models, one general-purpose and two for biosignals, on 14 to 17 of 19, with none exceeding it on any task. translated_title: 一个在十种生理信号上预训练的心肺基础模型，用于围手术期与重症监护
translated_abstract: 动脉压、静脉压、肺动脉压和颅内压以及呼吸机波形指导着手术室和重症监护病房的临床决策，然而现有的生理波形基础模型几乎完全建立在心电图和光电容积脉搏波图之上。我们提出了CARMEN，一个单一编码器，在十种心肺波形上进行了无标签预训练（共227万模态小时）。CARMEN可以接受从10秒到5分钟的任意共录信号组合，并且通过一种名为LSCNorm的条件化机制恢复了归一化所丢失的绝对信号水平；若没有该机制，术中低血压预测的AUROC将从0.894下降至0.780。在来自韩国和美国队列的19个任务上，该冻结编码器在15个任务中的12个上优于监督模型，在19个任务中的14至17个上优于三个基础模型（一个通用模型和两个生物信号模型），且没有任何一个模型在任何任务上超越它。仅凭心电图或光电容积脉搏波图（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: CARMEN是一个在十种心肺生理波形上无标签预训练的基础模型，通过LSCNorm机制保留绝对信号水平，能灵活接受任意信号组合，并在围手术期与重症监护的19项任务中超越了监督模型和其他基础模型。
en_tdlr: CARMEN is a cardiorespiratory foundation model pretrained label-free on ten physiological waveforms, which uses an LSCNorm conditioning mechanism to preserve absolute signal levels and outperforms supervised models and existing foundation models across 19 perioperative and critical care tasks.
